The company shows adequate short-term liquidity (current ratio ≈ 2.2) and solid operating profitability (EBIT/operating income of 727M on 4,165M revenue). However, the materially negative retained earnings (-1,086M) indicate accumulated losses and weaker cushion, while leverage remains fairly high (total liabilities 3,366M vs. total assets 4,997M). Overall, this points to credit risk in the speculative, sub-investment grade area rather than a higher-quality profile.

DECISION: BB-
